title: Customer Care System Reference: Delay Credit Accepted on Deposit-Program Ridgeline Special Order Services Orders
content:
**Applies to.** The delay credit on a Ridgeline Special Order Services order in a program whose deposit at order is 50 percent, when the order's delay — the calendar days by which the estimated ready date, or the ready date once the item is ready, is later than the promised ready date — is above the program's vendor delay threshold and the customer chooses to keep the order and take the credit. The credit is posted once, as a delay credit, at the customer's request.

## Conditions of the credit

The delay credit is not worked out until every damage allowance owed for a damage claim registered on the order stands as a credit on it.

Before the delay credit is fixed, the home delivery charge owed for a delivered order must stand on the order as a fee line.

A delay credit on an order the store has released is booked only after the storage charge owed for the days held past the free hold period stands on the order.

**Business effect.** Accepting the credit registers the customer's delay remedy request with the choice of the delay credit, marked completed today, and books one delay credit line, dated today, that lowers the order's balance due by the credit. The customer sees the remedy recorded and the credit on the order.

## Tool: `accept_delay_credit_eaface8f`

**Capability.** Records the customer's own choice to keep a special order the vendor delivered late and take the delay credit offered.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it, through `call_user_discoverable_tool`, with the parameters below.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `special_order_id` | the reference number of the delayed special order, as returned by the special order lookup for this customer | identifier, as returned by the lookup |
| `credit_amount` | the delay credit being accepted | US dollars as a plain number with 2 decimal places (for example 140.25); the tool rounds to the nearest cent |

Neither parameter has an enumerated set of values.

**Return.** A confirmation sentence that begins "Delay credit accepted" when the choice and the credit were recorded, carrying the delay remedy request reference number (text starting "sorq"), the credit line reference number (text starting "sodly"), the credit (US dollars, 2 decimals) and the order's new balance due (US dollars, 2 decimals, negative when money is owed back).

## Reference questions

**Who runs the tool?** The customer themselves, after the agent has unlocked it and handed it over.

**Does the customer need an existing delay remedy request?** No. The tool itself registers the delay remedy request, with the delay credit as the choice, and marks it completed.
